decision_use: Understand the participatory process that shaped and validated the NCAIF and Data Management Framework, assuring them of stakeholder buy-in and practical grounding.
section_job: Summarize the participatory activities and the significant resulting changes/validations to the NCAIF and Data Management Framework.
target_altitude: Executive overview of process value; high-level changes and validations derived from stakeholder feedback, not a chronological meeting log.
inclusions: overview of participation (internal FGDs, external hearing, interviews)
significant changes to NCAIF structure, navigation, and scope
key insights and validations gained from FGDs
exclusions: meeting dates, locations, schedules, participant lists
evidence_policy: Use verified facts in prose; focus on the 'feedback -> decision -> change' logic.
